explanation: The statement is entirely about library-specific notions: `Subfunctor.IsOneCoverDense` and its associated extension `hD.grpObj hF` (a `GrpObj F` constructed in SchemeProperties/SingleCoverGroup.lean via `mulExtension`/`extendOneCover`), which have no counterpart in Mathlib. Searches of Mathlib for `IsOneCoverDense`, `oneCoverExtension`, `mulExtension` and `grpObj` turn up only unrelated material (`Functor.grpObjObj`, `FullyFaithful.grpObj`, `Over.grpObjMkPullbackSnd`, `smooth_of_grpObj`, etc.), none of which states anything about the group law extending along a one-cover-dense subfunctor. Mathlib's `CategoryTheory.Subfunctor` files (Basic, Image, OfSection, Finite, Equalizer, Subobject, Sieves) contain no such result either. The theorem is just the componentwise (`types_comp_apply`) form of the library's own `grpObj_mul_ι`, so the mathematical content lives in library definitions rather than in any Mathlib declaration.
